title: Batch 9 - account list page and shared list page

states.ids: A1, A2, A3, A5, A41, first-screen rule
states.what: The list. 1180: controls in the side column («Поделиться», «Печать», «Бросить по списку», «Ещё»), «Цены:» with an example and both list notes there, «Выбрать» over the rows. 360: the side column becomes a head - the name as the h1 input (rules 15, 16) with «Ещё» («Выбрать», «Цены» as two choices with an example, copy, JSON, delete), the meta line with «Заметки ▾», then «Поделиться», «Печать» and «Бросить по списку». Rows: the position field and the grip, labelled quantity and price, «Заметка» and «Ещё». At 768 the side column moves on top (A1, P0).
Longest name: a 200-character list name in the h1 input, one line that scrolls in the field (rules 15, 16).
Open at 360: «Заметки ▾» on the meta line opens both list notes in place, so they are reached without scrolling past the entries. At 1180 the notes are in the side column.
Open and focus: one note area per row with a «Для игроков» / «Только для мастера» switch (a dot marks a filled note); the field has the focus ring.
Open: the switch on «Только для мастера»: the field takes the dashed GM style, the caption says players do not see it.

Open: the list «Ещё» menu: at 360 «Цены» (book units or coins, each with its example), then copy text, download JSON, delete apart. The rename is the h1 input (rules 15, 16); «Выбрать» is on the title row at 360.
Open: a row's «Ещё» menu: show to or hide from players, open the card, then remove. The hidden row carries the «Только для мастера» badge.

Drag: the dragged row dims; the drop mark is one horizontal gold rule drawn on both rows beside the gap (FEATURES.md, "Lists"), not a side stripe. The grip shows only where a pointer can hover; at 360 the position field reorders.
Open: the share panel: two labelled link rows with path addresses (/s/<token>), «Скопировать» neutral (not gold), one danger action.
«Цены: Как в книге»: every price on the page reads in bags and handfuls, the example under the switch too.
Open: one entry selected, the prices panel (markup, the book price for its rarity).
Empty: no prices yet; the panel offers the book price for the rarity.
Selected with a part quantity: «Взять 1 из 2 = 7 мешков 5 горстей», the bar total follows.

Open: two entries ticked. The one selection bar: «Все» (a dash while some are ticked), «Выбрано: 2 · 7 шт. · Итого: 400 зол.», «Цены», «Скопировать текст», «Удалить (2)», «Снять выделение» last. At 360 pinned to the bottom of the 640 px frame.
The selection mode with no tick: «Все» empty, «Выбрано: 0», «Цены», «Скопировать текст» and «Удалить (0)» off, «Снять выделение» on.
The undo toast after a sale; the toast pattern is batch 2's (unit A).
Open: «Бросить по списку» with a result. At 360 the compact card (96 px art beside the text); from 600 px the full card face. The rolled entry, the notes and «Показать в списке» under it.

Requests waiting. At 360 the panel is folded to its head, «Новое в списке (3)» and «Открыть» (owner, 2026-10-29), so the first entry stays in the first screen; at 1180 it is open above the entries. «Принять» is gold on the first request only.
Open: «Открыть» pressed at 360. The panel takes the head row with «Свернуть»; the entries start below it. At 1180 the panel is always open, as list-requests.
Empty: the empty-state pattern (batch 3) with the cause and one next step.
At the limit: 100 of 100; «Добавить свой предмет» is off and the line says why and what to do.
Error: a write failed; the meta line says «не сохранено», the alert names the cause and «Повторить».

The players' link: the count and «Заметка ▾» on the lead line, one action row with «Сохранить себе» as the one primary and «Выбрать» («Печать» joins it at 1180; at 360 it is in the selection bar), labelled quantity and price, no checkboxes until «Выбрать».
Longest name: a 200-character list name; one line with an ellipsis at 360 (two lines measured 260-282 px, past the limit), three lines at 1180.
Open: «Заметка ▾» opens the list note in place under the lead line.
The GM's link: «Заметка мастера ▾» on the lead line beside the players' note link; the GM-only entry and its note show in the same dashed style as the owner's editor (A22).
Open: «Заметка мастера ▾» opens the GM's list note in place, dashed as in the owner's editor.
The owner opens their own link: one line says what this link hides and links to the editor.

Open: two entries ticked. The one selection bar: «Все», «Выбрано: 2 · 2 шт.», «В список», «Печать», «Скопировать текст», «Снять выделение» last; «Сообщить владельцу» on its own line under it, not gold.
The selection mode with no tick on the shared page: «Все» empty, «Выбрано: 0», the actions and «Сообщить владельцу» off, «Снять выделение» on.

The filter sheet at 360 with one source picked: «Фильтры · 1» lit, the count «Показано 8 из 12» on the lead line, «Ссылка на фильтры» in the sheet head, «Сбросить» and «Показать 8» in its foot; at 1180 the column head carries «Сбросить» and the link.
Error page: the link is off or the list is gone; the error-page pattern (batch 4) with a true cause and one next step.
